plugins.name: intake
plugins.description: Per-project QA profile: /qa-init scans the target project once — issue tracker repo, issue templates, labels, app launch method, test conventions — and freezes it into qa/intake.md, which every other QA plugin reads. Committed to the project repo so the whole team shares one profile.

plugins.name: testrun
plugins.description: Test execution: launches the actual product and exercises it — plan-driven when a plan exists, ad-hoc smoke otherwise. Every verdict carries evidence (command output, screenshot, log); run records land under qa/runs/. Report, don't fix: findings become issues, never edits to product code.

plugins.name: bugreport
plugins.description: Bug filing discipline: a confirmed, actually-reproduced defect becomes a tracker issue that follows the project's own issue template and labels (per qa/intake.md), with duplicate search before filing and a standard form as fallback.

plugins.name: qa-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install QA environment bundle: pulls in the whole tokenmaxxxer QA stack (intake, testrun, bugreport) as dependencies. Contains no code of its own.
